source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Ceiling height 3.0m assumed pending elevation check.

1F window sill/head heights measured from North_view.png dimension chain: 1.0-2.6m absolute (claim_0002), applied uniformly across the 1F window family including the corridor east window (unresolved distinction noted).
Door heights assumed 2.1m pending elevation confirmation.
Walls modeled as zero-thickness representative centerlines/faces; 240mm/250mm wall thickness labels not separately modeled as solids.
Room A-bottom furniture (closet, L-fixture) interpreted as storage/pantry use, not a separate plumbed room, since no partition separates them from the entry area.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

2F exterior window heights measured from North_view.png elevation chain (claim_0003): absolute 4.0-5.8m, applied to all 8 exterior windows including east/west corridor windows (unresolved family-distinction noted). Interior door heights (12 corridor-to-room doors across both floors) and the west exterior corridor door (F1:D_west) remain explicit 2.1m assumptions; no elevation fine-dimension was available for these openings.
West/East corridor windows assumed same height family as the other 2F windows.
Walls modeled as zero-thickness representative centerlines; 400mm corridor wall thickness and other wall thicknesses not separately modeled as solids.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

unresolved: Exact room use for room_A_bot (closet+L-fixture) not verified beyond furniture inference.
Small double-tick dimension marks (~120mm each) at x=5000/10000 in the top chain interpreted as the partition wall thickness crossing the window run; not independently confirmed.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
Exact per-window elevation distinction between corridor windows (east/west) and room windows (north/south) not independently confirmed beyond shared family assumption.
Small partition thickness (~120mm gap in top dimension chain) interpreted as wall crossing the window run; not independently confirmed.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Matches independently derived value; consistent 3000mm 1F floor height closure.

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain below the 2F/1F floor line (z=3.0m) reads top-down 400(ceiling-to-head)+1600(window leaf)+1000(sill-to-ground)=3000mm=1F floor height. Segment 1 (the 1600mm leaf) gives absolute head/sill z=1.0-2.6m. Applied uniformly to all 1F exterior windows.
unresolved: West/East elevations show the same corridor window family without a separate fine dimension chain; assumed to match this measured North/South family.

decision.reason: Matches expected 2F window family; consistent 3600mm floor-to-roof closure.

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain above the 2F/1F floor line reads top-down 800(roof-to-head)+1800(window leaf)+1000(sill-to-floor)=3600mm=2F floor-to-roof height, origin at roof z=6.6m absolute. Segment 1 (the 1800mm leaf) gives absolute head/sill z=4.0-5.8m. Applied uniformly to all 2F exterior windows.

decision.reason: Confirms already-assumed 2.1m south door height with actual elevation evidence.

claims.reason: South_view.png right-side chain below the 1F/2F floor line reads top-down 900(floor-to-head gap)+600(transom)+1500(leaf)=3000mm=1F floor height, origin z=3.0m. Segments 1+2 combined (600+1500=2100mm) span absolute z=0 to 2.1m, matching the already-assumed 2.1m door height exactly.

after: 1F window sill/head heights measured from North_view.png dimension chain: 1.0-2.6m absolute (claim_0002), applied uniformly across the 1F window family including the corridor east window (unresolved distinction noted).
